## Tests (1 behavioral contract)

### test_mirror_defenses_idempotency
Given: a ticket with 2 defense records (DEFENSE_RECORD: comments)
And: STUB_GH_SCENARIO=existing_comments → gh pr view --comments returns 1 existing defense comment (already posted)
When: mirror_defenses_to_pr called twice in succession
Then:
- First call: posts only the 1 NEW defense comment (the 1 already-posted is skipped)
- GH_CALL_LOG shows exactly 1 'pr comment create' entry (not 2)
- Second call (re-run): GH_CALL_LOG shows 0 additional 'pr comment create' entries (all already posted)
- Total 'pr comment create' calls across both invocations: exactly 1

## Setup pattern
Same gh PATH-stub as test-github-defense-store.sh plus TICKET_CMD stub returning 2 DEFENSE_RECORD comments.

```
STUB_GH_SCENARIO=existing_comments → gh pr view --comments returns JSON with 1 DEFENSE_RECORD body already posted
TICKET_CMD stub returns ticket JSON with 2 DEFENSE_RECORD: comments (one matching the existing PR comment, one new)
```
